title: Feedback on Short-term Home Rentals and Prior Approval by Property Owners
what_it_is: Feedback on Short-term Home Rentals and Prior Approval by Property Owners

sections.label: URA studying feedback on regulation
sections.summary: URA is studying all feedback received before deciding how to proceed, including the final regulatory approach and possible legislative amendments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: URA is carefully studying all the feedback that we have received and we will do so before deciding on how to take this issue forward, including how to structure the final regulatory approach and whether there is a need for any legislative amendments.

sections.label: Minimum stay duration still applies
sections.summary: The minimum stay duration of three consecutive months for private residential properties still applies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Even as we do so, even as we consider the deliberations very carefully, I would emphasise that the minimum stay duration of three consecutive months for private residential properties still applies.

sections.label: Reports of unauthorised short-term accommodation
sections.summary: From 2015 to 2017, URA received 1,808 reports of unauthorised STA in private residential units, and HDB received 390 reports of STA in HDB flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: From 2015 to 2017, URA received 1,808 reports of unauthorised STA in private residential units.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In the same period, HDB received 390 reports of STA in HDB flats.

sections.label: Enforcement notices and possible prosecution
sections.summary: Enforcement notices will be issued to all of them, and URA will work with AGC on prosecution for continuing or egregious cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For all of them, enforcement notices will be issued.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: A good majority of them will then stop and immediately comply with the enforcement notice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But should there be cases that continue or there are egregious cases, then, indeed, URA will work with AGC on prosecution.

sections.label: Sufficient resources for expeditious enforcement
sections.summary: The speaker hopes the Minister can clarify and will ask URA to ensure sufficient resources for enforcement done expeditiously.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I hope the Minister can clarify on this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I will ask URA to make sure that they have sufficient resources to carry out the enforcement and make sure that this is done expeditiously.
